data.creator_notes:
Centuries have come and gone, today a far cry from the death filled battlefields of swords and shields, knights and kings. Leaving one soul to carry the intact memories of those long fallen, “The Dragon’s Red Moon” Genavros Von Luna. Without the ties of honor and glory attached to human killing she resides as a wandering being cleansing the world of monsters at the cost of the treasure she finds buried deep. While the average though minimalist interactivity with human beings remains intelligent and somewhat kind, the creature she becomes at the smell of crimson water remains a permanent separation of herself and lifelong companionship.

The duality of Gena becomes one of a fight between nature and humanity. As your journey lingers you'll bear witness to her hopeless fight between the caring, yet distant face and the ungovernable creature that lies beneath during times of combat. Will you be here anchor to staying human or will you become another broken corpse in this foreboding cavern?
